summary: Fresh import verification of Semoyo Joyo (B2B E-Commerce + Mini ERP). Focused pytest suite (17 tests, 100% pass) covering health, catalog, checkout, RBAC, dashboard, expenses, reports, exports. Playwright verification of homepage, /rahasia-admin login for both owner & admin, all 8 owner pages, OwnerRoute redirects, and /admin logged-out redirect. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Spec says redirect to homepage; actual behavior redirects to /rahasia-admin (admin login). Acceptable UX for staff-facing route but deviates slightly from spec wording. Not a bug.

passed_tests: GET /api/health -> status ok, db_connected true, payment_mode simulation
POST /api/checkout (COD) creates order with SJ- prefix and returns access_token
Owner dashboard exposes gross_profit / net_profit / cost_paid / total_expenses
Admin dashboard finance fields forced to 0 and profit_by_product empty (RBAC)
Homepage loads with 7 category chips, hero, product grid rendering (Beras & Karbohidrat etc.)
/rahasia-admin login form present with admin-username-input / admin-password-input / admin-login-button testids
Owner login owner/owner123 -> /admin/dashboard shows KPI cards: Omzet, Total Modal (HPP), Laba Kotor, Laba Bersih
Owner can load: /admin/produk (91 total incl. inactive), /admin/stok, /admin/pesanan, /admin/piutang, /admin/pengeluaran, /admin/laporan, /admin/pengaturan, /admin/audit-log without errors
Admin login admin/admin123 -> dashboard hides Laba Bersih, HPP, and 'Keuangan · Laba/Rugi' section
Admin sidebar hides Laporan, Audit Log, Pengaturan links
/admin (logged out) redirects away from admin surface (to /rahasia-admin)
critical_code_review_comments: server-sent-events endpoint /api/admin/events keeps connection open, so Playwright's 'networkidle' hangs on admin pages. Not a bug, but tests must use domcontentloaded.
Bare /admin (logged out) redirects to /rahasia-admin instead of homepage per spec. Consider changing AdminRoute to redirect to '/' when spec is authoritative, or update the spec.
test_credentials: admin/admin123 (role admin), owner/owner123 (role owner) — verified working via /rahasia-admin
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test order (customer TEST_<random>, product[0], COD) and 1 test expense (operasional, Rp 50.000, 2026-01-15) via API. No dummy order-seed script used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh import verified end-to-end. DB seeded with 7 categories + 58 active products (+33 inactive = 91 total shown in admin/produk). Prior batch tests exist at /app/backend_test.py and /app/backend_test_batch2.py; new focused suite at /app/backend/tests/test_import_verify.py. Admin routes: /api/admin/settings/store (not /store), /api/admin/audit-logs (with 's'), order status literals are Indonesian (baru/diproses/dikirim/selesai/dibatalkan). Checkout uses full_name/phone/address/items[{product_id,qty}] via POST /api/checkout and returns {order, access_token, user, payment}. Playwright must use wait_until='domcontentloaded' on admin pages (SSE keeps network alive).
